'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Kelly DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Kelly]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
